description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of a Git hook during push operations, particularly focusing on processing refs, handling errors, and outputting status messages. It includes setup for hooks, executing Git push commands, and validating output and refs.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_tool proc-receive
methods.description: Simulates the 'proc-receive' tool used in testing hooks.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output into a stable, user-friendly format.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares current refs to expected refs.
